phase_1_intraday_data.details: Adds yfinance-safe recent 5m/15m/1h intraday feature blocks, neutral-filled for older daily rows. Full 1m/4h multi-year coverage still needs Polygon/Alpaca storage.

phase_2_vwap_features.details: Adds intraday price-above-VWAP, VWAP distance, VWAP slope, reclaim, and rejection features for available recent intraday windows.

phase_3_multi_timeframe_alignment.details: Adds 5m/15m/1h trend features and bullish/bearish/mixed multi-timeframe alignment scores. 4h/daily/weekly stacked alignment is pending.

phase_4_market_regime_detection.details: SPY/QQQ trend, VIX regime, volatility, and yield proxy features are included. Full regime classifier is pending.

phase_5_macro_vix_data.details: VIX and 10-year yield proxy are included from Yahoo. FRED inflation, GDP, unemployment, Fed/CPI calendars are pending.

phase_6_sector_rotation.details: Sector ETF returns, basket strength, dispersion, and stock-vs-sector basket strength are included.

phase_7_news_sentiment.details: FinBERT/OpenAI sentiment pipeline is not part of this Kaggle training script yet.

phase_8_event_flags.details: Earnings, Fed, CPI, OPEX, and major-event flags require event calendar ingestion.

phase_9_improved_labels.details: Adds and trains models for 3-class ATR labels, binary direction, breakout, breakdown, reversal, volatility expansion, future return, future range, and risk-adjusted return targets.

phase_10_confidence_filtering.details: Reports all-signal and >=60/70/80/85 confidence bucket accuracy with coverage.

phase_11_historical_similarity.details: Backend has a similarity service. Training artifact does not yet ensemble it.

phase_12_monte_carlo_simulation.details: Backend simulation exists. Training artifact does not yet save Monte Carlo calibration parameters.

phase_13_sequence_models.details: LSTM/GRU/Transformer/TFT should come after feature and label quality improves.

phase_14_ensemble_strategy.details: Stable artifact trains multiple XGBoost classifiers/regressors. LightGBM/CatBoost hooks remain disabled because previous Kaggle GPU runs warned/segfaulted.

phase_15_walk_forward_validation.details: Optuna uses TimeSeriesSplit and final holdout is chronological. Full rolling walk-forward backtest windows are pending.

phase_16_drift_retraining.details: Model/version metadata is saved; automated drift detection and retraining scheduler are pending.

phase_17_llm_explanation_layer.details: Metrics and backend provide explanation-ready facts. LLM remains explanation-only, not a direct price predictor.

phase_18_strategy_aware_prediction.details: Adds setup detectors and v7 setup-only strategy-quality targets for breakout long, breakdown short, pullback continuation, mean reversion, squeeze breakout, VWAP reclaim, and RSI divergence short.

phase_19_strategy_quality_validation.details: Reports strategy quality only on active setup rows: signal count, coverage, win rate, profit factor, average win/loss, max drawdown, Sharpe, MFE/MAE, expected return, and risk/reward.

phase_20_strategy_filtered_prediction.details: Adds a v8 high-quality strategy opportunity model trained only on v7-positive long setups instead of all candles, with accuracy and confidence buckets reported against disclosed coverage.

phase_21_specialist_strategy_models.details: Adds v9 specialist models for breakout long, mean reversion long, and VWAP reclaim, with separate setup-only probability, expected return, risk/reward, confidence buckets, and coverage proof.

phase_22_elite_trade_quality_models.details: Adds v10 elite trade-quality models for breakout long and mean reversion long only, requiring target-before-stop success, positive return, and minimum realized risk/reward.

phase_23_breakout_precision_optimization.details: Adds v11 breakout-only class-weight variants and positive-probability precision buckets to optimize high-confidence TAKE-trade filtering.

phase_24_final_hybrid_artifact.details: Adds v12 final hybrid policy that combines all model layers but promotes only the best validated signal, elite breakout quality, with all accuracy claims tied to confidence threshold and coverage.

extra_technical_volume_divergence.details: Adds SMA/WMA/EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR/ADX, 2x/3x volume spikes, volume-confirmed breakouts/breakdowns, and RSI bullish/bearish divergence features.

honesty_policy: Outputs are probability-based market simulations and AI-generated financial intelligence, not financial advice. Accuracy claims must include validation method, confidence threshold, and coverage.
